checks: A data-only Character and Artwork appear through the shared gallery query and card component.
The shared card is rendered and addressable by its data ID.
Query and ordinary card rendering do not fetch the original PNG.
The shared detail controller opens the fixture from the card without a character-specific page.
Detail cover and sharper preview use registered display derivatives; original bytes remain unloaded.
The unified Chinese Prompt copies and opens in ChatGPT with extra intent while leaving the static preview unchanged.
The primary static Export action returns exact registered PNG bytes and SHA-256 through the injected fixture resolver.
The isolated fixture flow does not mutate its source Artwork record.
